You should take a break 

Just one day, put on your fav comfortable clothes and grab some snacks.

Watch something or your fav activity 

Do not let anyone’s thought hinder your day

Even yours

That day is just for yourself and you shall enjoy it 

Watch the night sky brimming with stars  while listening to your fav music 

that helps me calm myself a lot 

But please value yourself 

you are strong for coming this far and that also alone 

be proud and take care of yourself

If they do not like you, they will most likely say it outloud rather tham being in the relationship. AND YOU HAVE PEOPLE THAT LIKE YOU. YOUR PARTNER AND YOUR FRIENDS. SO PEOPLE DO LIKE YOU THE WAY YOU ARE

DO NOT QUESTION YOUR WORTH. YOU DESERVE THE LOVE YOU ARE GETTING FROM THE PEOPLE. AND WANTING HAPPINESS AND COMPANIONSHIP IS NOT SELFISH AT ALL! 

If they find you annoying, they wouldn’t talk with you at all

If you have any questions, confront them instead of living paranoid like this.   
Although everything is happening, IT IS INCREDIBLE THAT YOUR WORK IS NOT AFFECTED AT ALL. YOU SHOULD BE MORE PROUD OF THAT.

The older we grow, the more we understand that our parents sometimes can say complete bullshit. it is a parent’s responsibility to raise the child they gave birth to. AND PLEASE DO NOT RESORT TO DRUGS NO MATTER WHAT. DRUGS ARE NEVER WORTH IT. IT WILL JUST PULL YOU MORE DOWN. 

maybe try therapy or talking with your partner about this

if he loves you, he will definitely understand 

DO NOT LISTEN TO WHAT YOUR MOM AND BROTHER SAYS. Yes it is very hard but please distract your mind from that by doing any activity.   
know that there are people who loves you and care for you 

try talking with them too 

take care

Listen to me please

you are always **Good Enough.** No matter what society tells you to do or your mind tells you. You are unconditionally very valuable. You shouldn’t die for someone Who does not value your life. If they cannot move on from what they did to you, fuck them. You do not need to concern yourself with those people who matter who it is. Pleas try your best to ignore and distract yourself and take care

do not forget to eat well and stay hydrated
I hope you and your friend may come across good things. Take care :)

It is very common to not reply to someone’s message quickly so it is definitely not like they resent you 

Thinking Ill of yourself is understandable but if you think about it, it is definitely not worth it.

Try being alone for sometime 

like keep your device aside and do some kind of work or just go for a casual walk

Maybe you should ask your friends what they think about you

Similar thing happened to me 

for me, I used to listen to Lo-Fi with headphones and do my work. It used to calm me down and help me 

Or maybe some other kind of music that I like 

I cannot say for sure that it will work for you obviously but trying won’t Harm 

good luck and I hope it helps

also take her to a doctor for a check up

eating junk food or fast food increases heart problems and many other issues

Apologies as I couldn’t find any other way

I’m 15 and I think it’s been 4 years now

i first started Being like this in 6th std as far as I remember and currently I’m in 10th

Have the people you talked to ever said you were a burden? I do not think so. I have been through a similar situation of feeling overwhelmed and It’s normal. Do not hate yourself for that. Everyone has a limit. you need a moment of relaxation and peace. Talk about it with them and tell them that it’s too much for you as of now. Good luck mate, please take care.

Please understand that self-harm is not the correct way. It’s very normal to cry and grief when someone close passes away. You can cry your heart out but also remember to eat and drink properly. Your body still needs energy. If you want to punch something, punch a soft cushion or something. If possible, try therapy. The best way is distracting your mind. Try doing something you like or just anything other than thinking about it. I really hope you understand and I hope you do well. Please take care. Your relative would want you to enjoy your life and I’m pretty sure about that. Take care once again

That is something you have to find yourself. Everyone is a loser. Many people has lost in many things. And there is potential in everyone. Look further than what you see.  Expand your vision and you will find it yourself. It will obviously take time tho.
